title: Shah Bhen Day Saamnay Ro Ro
body:
Shah Bhen Day Saamnay Ro Ro Kay Lar Pag Da Aap
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah Bhen Day Saamnay Ro Ro Kay Lar Pag Da Aap Phehlaavay Mainku Akbar Putar Wala Way
<<DIVIDER>>
Saadi Aakhri Raat Ey Dil Ahdaaey Akbar Azaan Sunavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloomi Day Kanoon Day Vich Ee Darad Da Hovan Laazim Hey
Akbar Jeya Sohna Puttar Howay Pyu Tahtul Hanak Walaavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Medi Marzi Hey Jo Dafan Theevo Pyu Puttar Einji Tarteeb Day Vich
Meda Hath Akbar Day Jigar Utay Shaala Mehshar Taeen Raahway
<<DIVIDER>>
Maikun Nanay Mohar Tay Chaya Haa Mei Karaz Lahaavanaey Nanay Da
Hamshakel Rasool Koun Cha Ghinsaan Toray Koi Na Laash Chavaaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad Janazay Vaang Sadaa Tedi Marzi Naal Wadha Tursi
Mein Chahanaa Haan Mede Hissay Vich Akbar Da Laasha Aaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Kul Mursal Daikhin Kerbal Vich Mein Sohnay Puttar Koun Kharach Karan
Ban Fakhr-e-Ismaeel Meda Akbar Maqtal Vich Aavay
<<DIVIDER>>
